questions.question: What is the total cost of the pizzas for all the events?
questions.evidence: total cost of the pizzas refers to SUM(cost) where expense_description = 'Pizza'
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'

questions.question: List out the full name and total cost that member id "rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v" incurred?
questions.evidence: full name refers to first_name, last name
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, SUM(T2.cost) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v'

questions.question: Indicate the top source of funds received in September 2019 based on their amount.
questions.evidence: top source funds refers to MAX(source); September 2019 means date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' and '2019-09-30'
questions.SQL: SELECT source FROM income WHERE date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' and '2019-09-30' ORDER BY source DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which student has been entrusted to manage the budget for the Yearly Kickoff?
questions.evidence: name of students means the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;'Yearly Kickoff' is an event name;
questions.SQL: SELECT T4.first_name, T4.last_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget INNER JOIN member AS T4 ON T3.link_to_member = T4.member_id WHERE T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

questions.question: Among the students from the Student_Club who attended the event "Women's Soccer", how many of them want a T-shirt that's in medium size?
questions.evidence: Women's Soccer is an event name; T-shirt that is in medium size refers to t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T1.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' AND T3.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

questions.question: Was each expense in October Meeting on October 8, 2019 approved?
questions.evidence: event_name = 'October Meeting' where event_date = '2019-10-08'; approved = True means expenses was approved; approved = False means expenses was not approved
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.approved FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND T1.event_date LIKE '2019-10-08%'

questions.question: How many members of the Student_Club have major in 'Physics Teaching'?
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.member_id) FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T1.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'
